A type of civilian '''transport''' was used during the [[Imperial Era]]. At least two [[transport]]s were present on [[Anchorhead]], [[Tatooine]], one of which was boarded by fugitive [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to travel to [[Daiyu]].<ref name="Part I" />
The transport had a sloped [[hull]] with a flat ventral and dorsal side.<ref name="Part II" />
